The light theme's accent is a yellow again.

## ⚡ Improved

- **One token was doing two jobs, and the light theme paid for it.** The accent was swapped for a fixed dark yellow whenever the theme was light, which painted the heading, every filled badge and the send button olive-brown. A colour on a *fill* needs no darkening — Sunflower with near-black text on it reads perfectly well on a white page. What does need darkening is the same colour used as *text*, because gold on white is unreadable at 11px. Those are two jobs, so they are two tokens now: the fill keeps the colour, and the ink is derived from it (GlimStone 1.5.0). Derived rather than fixed matters here — the old constant only ever applied to the default accent, so a yellow somebody picked themselves stayed unreadable.

## 📋 Notes

- Same change is in the KnightLoader web interface and the app, from the same place: it is a design-language rule now, not a per-app choice.
